fusions.name: Still, Then Strike
fusions.desc: Throws your shield at a target at or below 25% health, dealing 28 damage.

fusions.name: Sunflash
fusions.desc: Turns the sun off the face of your shield through a cone 3 tiles ahead, dealing 10 damage, stunning everything in it for 1 second and leaving it [Blunted] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Sun Ledge
fusions.desc: Restores 4 health a second to you for 6 seconds and lifts 1 condition from you. You have 10% fire resistance while it lasts.

fusions.name: Sunlit Bulwark
fusions.desc: By day, your armour rises by 12%.
